body:
Source: release review of v1.11.1..main. Re-verified at the head of that range in packages/hollow-test:
- bin/hollow-test.mjs decided a changed file was comment-only from its ADDED lines alone (mutate.changedLinesFromDiff records only `+` lines). A diff replacing `if (!user.isAdmin) return false;` with `// admin check removed` (or a blank line), wrapping live code in an added `/*` ... `*/`, or deleting a closing `*/` was classified comment-only; when it was the only change the run exited 0 with 'comment-only diff - no changed behaviour to mutate', where the zero-mutant refusal should have exited 1.
- lib/targets.mjs's stateful comment scanner recognised a regex literal only after a punctuator. After `return`/`typeof`/`case` etc. a `/` was read as division, so a regex containing a backtick (`return /`/.test(x)`) opened a phantom template; two such regexes restored parity and a real template-data `// ...` line was classified comment-only.
- With --json, a comment-only skip exited 0 with EMPTY stdout (the skip report was text-only and pass(undefined) prints nothing), so JSON consumers such as the pi gate tool saw a bare pass with no skipped-file list; the normal JSON report also omitted skipped files.
- On a non-green baseline the bin wrote up to 128 KiB of diagnostics to stderr then called process.exit(1); on a piped stderr the queued tail, including the 'baseline suite is not green' reason line, was lost (reproduced on Linux: 8192 bytes received, reason absent).

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/hollow-test`: bin/hollow-test.mjs (CLI, target selection, comment-only filter, baseline check, reporting); lib/targets.mjs (source predicate, comment scanner, changedLinesAreCommentOnly); lib/report.mjs (table and JSON report); lib/runner.mjs (test runs, formatDiagnosticOutput); lib/inflight.mjs (crash recovery). New: lib/diff-deletions.mjs (old side of a diff), lib/exit.mjs (write-then-exit). Tests: `npm test -w packages/hollow-test`. CLI fixtures follow test/comment-only-diff.test.mjs (temp git repo in before, removed in after).

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. A changed file is comment-only only when fileChangeIsCommentOnly (lib/targets.mjs) holds: something was added or deleted; every added line is comment/blank in the working-tree source; every deleted line is comment/blank in the `--base` blob; and both sources scan trustworthily to the same program projection (comments dropped, whitespace runs reduced to one space or one newline, string/template/regex text kept verbatim). Any doubt (unreadable file, unreadable base blob, file absent from the old-side parse) keeps the file a mutation target. A reworded comment, a deleted comment and a comment-only new file remain comment-only.
2. deletedLinesFromDiff (lib/diff-deletions.mjs) consumes hunk bodies by their `@@` counts, so a deleted line beginning with `--` is a deletion, never a header; it records the old path (null for a created file).
3. The scanner treats `/` after return, typeof, throw, case, instanceof, delete, void, yield, else, do, in, of, new, await, default, extends (not preceded by `.`) as a regex start; after an ordinary identifier it stays division.
4. --json: the comment-only early exit prints buildJsonReport([]) plus `skipped: { commentOnly: [files] }` and exits 0; the normal JSON report carries the same field when any file was skipped. Text output unchanged.
5. A non-green baseline writes both diagnostic blocks and `error: baseline suite is not green (...)` in one write, awaits its flush, then exits 1.
6. Documentation: packages/hollow-test/README.md and, by hand, apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/hollow-test.mdx describe comment-only skips and the `skipped` field.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A code line replaced by a comment or a blank line, code wrapped in `/* */`, or a deleted `*/` does not pass as comment-only; the first three exit 1 with the zero-mutant refusal. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/comment-only-deletions.test.mjs`
- AC2 A reworded or deleted comment still exits 0 and names the file. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/comment-only-deletions.test.mjs`
- AC3 fileChangeIsCommentOnly and deletedLinesFromDiff behave as specified, including the `---counter;` deletion and a created file. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/comment-only-deletions.test.mjs`
- AC4 Keyword-led regexes containing a backtick do not invert a template; division after an identifier is unchanged. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/comment-only-deletions.test.mjs`
- AC5 `--json` on a comment-only diff prints a parseable report with skipped.commentOnly. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/comment-only-deletions.test.mjs`
- AC6 The baseline reason line survives a shell pipe. verify: `node --test packages/hollow-test/test/comment-only-deletions.test.mjs`
- AC7 Existing suite green. verify: `npm test -w packages/hollow-test`
- AC8 Docs updated in both places. verify: `grep -c "commentOnly" packages/hollow-test/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/hollow-test.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC9 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: deleted code in a diff that also adds mutable code elsewhere (diff-scoped mutation never mutates deleted lines); the `+++`-prefixed added-line ambiguity in @adlc/core changedLinesFromDiff; whole-file deletions; scripts/mutation-gate.mjs.
title: hollow-test: judge deleted lines and the whole program before skipping a diff as comment-only
